title: user.role_granted (v1) — EventEnvelope.data
description: A role was granted with the operator CLI (identity-service app/cli.py, ADR-0006). Producer: identity-service, topic `users`. Carries ids and status only, never email, phone or name (spec Section 14.2). Strict (additionalProperties: false) so any change to the payload is a reviewed contract change, never a silent one.

actor_user_id.description: Who did it: the user themselves for registration, the ADMIN for a status change, null for the operator CLI (app/cli.py).
